title: Longitudinal Analysis of Multiple Myeloma: Bone Marrow Recovery and Immune Microenvironment Dynamics in the Context of Tumor Heterogeneity.
description: Multiple myeloma (MM) is a hematologic malignancy characterized by expansion of malignant plasma cells in the bone marrow. In newly diagnosed MM (NDMM), standard triplet regimens such as bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone (VRd), along with the more recent addition of an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody, have improved outcomes by targeting complementary mechanisms. Treatment typically includes several cycles of induction therapy, high-dose melphalan (HDM) with autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT), and maintenance therapy. Responses vary widely, with some patients requiring prolonged or intensified therapy and others achieving deeper remissions more quickly.
